title: fix(plugin-audit, plugin-detail): a comment notification opens the comments at that comment
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTDAJKyXUan6fJCKsZUf5Pv)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziG2t1d9cfRQJDrHkB

Refs #36410 (item 1)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户点开"有人@你"或"有人回复了你"的通知后,记录页直接打开评论面板,并滚动到那条评论、高亮显示;电脑和手机都是这样。以前要自己去找评论。
- 属于记录页评论体验这一组改进,替每个跟着评论通知点进来的用户省掉翻找这一步。
- 出错时最坏情况是落到记录页但评论面板没打开(和以前一样);已经在收件箱里的旧通知仍按旧链接打开,可以直接撤回本改动。
- 无

## What changes

**Producer (`@objectstack/plugin-audit`, `audit-writers.ts`).** The `collab.mention` and `collab.reply` inbox emits now set `payload.url`, which messaging's existing `actionUrlFor` already honours, to `/{object}/{id}?comments={rootCommentId}`. When the comment is a reply, `&comment={commentId}` is added.
- Reply: the root is the thread's top-level comment, found by the same bounded `parent_id` walk `readThreadParticipants` already did. It is factored into `walkToThreadRoot`, and the participants read now also returns `rootId`.
- Mention in a top-level comment: the comment is its own thread, so there is no second param. Mention in a reply: the reply's top-level comment plus the reply. If the walk fails or finds no root, the link is the record alone, as before.
- Second param, chosen: `comment` names the exact comment to scroll to. It is written only when it differs from the thread root.
- The mention and reply e-mails (`mentionUrl`) carry the same link, made absolute through `getConsoleUrl` as before.
- **Inbox rows already stored keep their old `/{object}/{id}` link: there is no backfill.**
- Not touched: messaging's `actionUrlFor`, `packages/spec`, other notifications (the CONTROL pin shows a non-comment emit still gets the derived `/{object}/{id}`).

**Console.** `openInboxNotification` is unchanged: it already follows the link, query string included (`resolveNotificationTarget`).
- `urlParams.ts`: registers `comment` (`RECORD_COMMENT_PARAM`) beside `comments` in the reserved list. The `comments` doc now covers the desktop meaning.
- `RecordDetailView.tsx`, desktop: a non-empty `?comments=` opens the comment panel at that thread, whatever this browser last chose, and leaves the stored choice untouched. Closing the panel (its close button or the comments icon) drops `comments`/`comment` with a replace, so it stays closed. An empty `?comments=` on desktop means nothing (CONTROL pin).
- `RecordDetailView.tsx`, phone: the existing `?comments=` page opens the thread and hands `?comment=` to the page. Moving to another thread or going back drops `comment`.
- `recordCommentsPanel.tsx`: passes the focus through `RecordCommentsAside`.

**Scrolling lives in `@object-ui/plugin-detail`.**
- `CommentsPanel` takes `focusThreadId`/`focusCommentId`. It shows the thread past the filter (the filter goes to show all when it would hide the thread), opens its replies in the same commit (`CommentThread` `openSignal`), marks the comment (`CommentItem` `targeted`, `data-comment-target`) and scrolls only the list, never the page around it (`scrollCommentIntoView`).
- After that one scroll, the list stays where it is until a thread is added. Before this, a later `loading` flip snapped it back to the foot: the first desktop pin caught that.
- `CommentsPage` takes `focusCommentId`, and the thread opens scrolled to that comment, marked.

Fence note: the claim amendment names `RecordDetailView.tsx`. The new param's registration in `urlParams.ts` and the two-prop pass-through in `recordCommentsPanel.tsx` are the mechanical carriers of the seat-sanctioned second param and of the desktop entry, and are declared here. `NavigationOverlay` (item 2) is untouched.

## Tests

<details><summary>Pins added (each with a one-off ablation)</summary>

- `plugin-audit` `comment-reply-notice.integration.test.ts` (real ObjectQL on SQLite, real messaging pipeline, reading `sys_inbox_message.action_url`): reply, reply to a reply (root, not parent), mention in a top-level comment, mention in a reply (inbox and e-mail), and CONTROL: a non-comment notice keeps `/{object}/{id}`. The existing e-mail link assertions in this file, in `mention-email.integration.test.ts` and in `mention-recipient-gate.integration.test.ts` now read the comment link.
- `plugin-detail` `CommentsPanel.test.tsx`: a reply link opens the thread, marks the reply and scrolls the list (420 px on a laid-out box); a top-level link; the reader can collapse again; CONTROL with no link. `CommentsPanel.resolved-36075.test.tsx`: a resolved thread is shown past the default filter. `CommentsPage.test.tsx`: a thread opened at a reply scrolls to it; CONTROL opens at the top.
- `app-shell` `RecordDetailView.commentsPanel-36075.test.tsx`, through the real `RecordDetailView`: desktop `?comments=c-ada&comment=c-reply` opens the panel at the thread with the reply drawn, marked and scrolled to, and the stored choice untouched; closing drops the link; CONTROL: empty `?comments=` opens nothing. Phone: the same link opens the thread page scrolled to the reply, and going back drops `comment`.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one-off, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; every restore proven blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

1. Producer link drops the query (`if (!rootId) return recordPath;` changed to `return recordPath;`): 8 failed / 12 passed. All four link pins and the four e-mail-link assertions went red; the CONTROL stayed green.
2. Panel never scrolls to the linked comment: 3 failed (two panel pins plus the desktop RecordDetailView pin).
3. `CommentThread` ignores the open signal (`useState(openSignal != null)` changed to `useState(false)`): 3 failed (reply pin, collapse pin, desktop pin).
4. Phone page skips the scroll (line deleted): 2 failed (page pin plus the phone RecordDetailView pin).
5. Desktop ignores the link (`commentsOpenChosen` alone): 2 failed (the two desktop pins).

These are vitest suites over source (no `dist/` in the resolution path), so no rebuild leg was needed.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance "Opening a comment notification shows that comment without another click": met for new mention and reply notices, on desktop (the panel at the thread, scrolled, marked) and on phone (the thread page, scrolled, marked). Notices already stored open the record as before (no backfill).
- Comment kinds covered: `collab.mention` and `collab.reply`, the only comment notification topics in the tree. No "comment on a followed record" notification exists.
- The e-mail link goes to `/_console/{object}/{id}?…`. Whether the console's base-path redirect keeps the query is not measured here.
- Browser reach: NOT MEASURED. Following a real notice needs a full workspace build plus the showcase and console servers, on a shared box where the verification lock queued 5 to 9 minutes per run. The real-`RecordDetailView` pins above are the reach evidence instead.

## Verification

Read first:
1. `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts`: `commentRecordPath`, and the mention root walk (the extra read for a mention in a reply).
2. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/comments/CommentsPanel.tsx`: the two layout effects (foot versus linked comment) and the filter reveal.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`: `commentsLinkThread` and the wrapped `setCommentsOpen`.

Two-minute check: in a running showcase, @mention a second user in a reply on any record, sign in as that user and open the bell row. The record page opens with the comment panel at that thread, the replies open, and the reply highlighted in view.
